9.4.1. qnav.gps.ephemeris

9.4.1.1. ephemeris.py

summary:

Collection of functions for extracting GPS/GNSS information. This module is responsible for the util satellite functionality within the toolbox. This includes functions for downloading GPS information, parsing RINEX files, extracting satellite information and estimating missing values.

authors:
Michael Wright - mjwright@liverpool.ac.uk
Dr. Niall Moroney - niall.moroney17@imperial.ac.uk
version:

1.0.0 - First implementation of this module.

class qnav.gps.ephemeris.SatelliteType(value, names=<not given>, *values, module=None, qualname=None, type=None, start=1, boundary=None)[source]

Character identifiers for the different satellite types. These characters identify the record types corresponding to the satellite systems supported inside a Rinex File (as of version 4).

qnav.gps.ephemeris.get_rinex_path(gps_time: datetime, directory: Path) → Path[source]

Obtain the location of a local RINEX file identified by GPS date and time. This function will return the local filepath of a RINEX file corresponding to a given (python) datetime. The file of the returned path may or may not exist (requiring downloading if missing).

Parameters:

  • gps_time (datetime.datetime) – Python datetime object for the time required for the ephemeris.

  • directory (Path) – Location for the files to be downloaded to.

Returns:

The path of the corresponding RINEX file.

Return type:

Path

qnav.gps.ephemeris.download_rinex_file(gps_time: datetime, database_dir: Path)[source]

This function downloads and extracts an ephemeris file for a specified day from “cddis.gsfc.nasa.gov” and saves it under the provided directory.

Parameters:

  • gps_time – The Python datetime object for the time required for the ephemeris data.

  • database_dir (Path) – The location for the files to be downloaded to.

Type:

datetime.datetime

qnav.gps.ephemeris.download_rinex_files(from_time: datetime, to_time: datetime, database_dir: Path, inc_last: bool = True)[source]

This function downloads and extracts multiple ephemeris files. Given a date range, this function will download all the ephemeris files covered by the range.

Parameters:

  • from_time (datetime.datetime) – The first date for the download range. This is the date for the first GPS file to be downloaded.

  • to_time (datetime.datetime) – The last date for the download range. This is the end date for the GPS files to download.

  • database_dir (Path) – The location for the files to be downloaded to.

  • inc_last (bool) – Should the last date of the range be included?

qnav.gps.ephemeris.read_rinex_file(ephemeris_file: Path) → dict[str, dict][source]

Parses a downloaded ephemeris file and returns its data. Reads a given ephemeris file, skipping the header contents and returning the contained entry records in dictionaries. Each is keyed by the ID of the satellite.

Parameters:

ephemeris_file (Path) – The local ephemeris file to read.

Returns:

A dictionary of extracted satellite parameters.

Return type:

dict[str, dict]

qnav.gps.ephemeris.rinex_to_satellite_params(rinex_data: dict, *satellite_types: SatelliteType) → list[SatelliteParams][source]

Extracts given rinex data and converts into satellite parameters class. A helper function for extracting the usable satellite parameter data from given Rinex data, allowing for satellite instances to be created. Optional filtering can also be supplied to limit returns to specific satellite types.

Parameters:

  • rinex_data (dict[str, dict]) – The data records read from a Rinex file.

  • satellite_types (SatelliteType) – (Optional) The satellite types to filter by. By default, all types are selected and no filtering is performed.

Returns:

The satellite parameters for each rinex record.

Return type:

list[SatelliteParams]
